# Miya Crit Route Draft

This build branch buys an earlier spike only if the lane remains stable without outside rescue.

## What to watch

- Check whether the route survives two-wave pressure.
- Compare objective damage against the safer baseline.
- Reject the setup if it only works when already ahead.

## Draft focus

A faster curve matters only if it does not outsource lane stability to the rest of the draft.

> The build is interesting only if the map can trust it.

More on Miya: keep this read connected to marksman gold structures, not just isolated mechanics.
